description.en: The ID of the region where the cloud service is accessed.
The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

description.zh:
云服务的服务地址。

支持输入域名、IP地址或IP地址段。
description.en:
The endpoint of the Alibaba Cloud service.

The endpoint can be a domain name, an IP address, or a CIDR block.

description.zh:
云服务所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Alibaba Cloud service is deployed.

Call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain the region ID.
The ID of the VPC that is associated with the Alibaba Cloud service.
The page number. The default value is **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为**10**，取值范围：**1**~**50**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn describe-route-services-in-cen --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-pfa6ugf3xl0qsd0000 --host 100.118.28.0/24 --host-region-id cn-hangzhou --access-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-vpc-id vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000 --region cn-hangzhou
